actual: QE automatic evolution results page /quantevolver/evolution shows Incomplete metrics for non-selected loops after a multi-loop experiment completes. Only the selected/last loop has full comparison metrics because the frontend loads summary task data initially and lazy-loads full loop metrics on click; backend summary/comparison payloads do not expose compact enhanced metrics needed by the comparison table. Fix backend compact payloads and frontend hydration so completed loops display complete metrics without per-loop manual selection.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
